lines.text: In this city, electricity is banned after dark, and nobody will say why.
Ferro was the city's hero, with one big problem.
His whole suit was made of fridge magnets.
So he was the only one who could fight at night.
That night, Mister Lumen flipped every switch in town.
Streetlights. Neon signs. Even the toasters.
Everything lit up at once.
And the sky started to rumble.
Ferro ran outside, and nobody could tell him why.
Then it got worse.
Huge shadows slid across the rooftops.
Wings, each one as big as a bus.
The crowd screamed, and hid behind their lamps.
Ferro tried his magnets, but giant moths don't care about magnets.
By midnight, the whole city was covered in fluff.
And every light was still on.
Then he saw it: the biggest lamp in town, on a steel pole.
He stuck it to his back, with one huge magnet, and ran.
And the moths followed the glow, out of the city, and over the sea.
See, night moths steer by the brightest light they can see.
That's why they circle every lamp.
Ferro came home at dawn, and switched every light off.
Which is why, in this city, electricity is banned after dark.
